ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Process Access Rights For Target Image
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects process access request to uncommon target images with a "PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS" access mask.
 Note: Unmapped fields: TargetImage, GrantedAccess

sequences.query: ((TargetImage = RGX("\\\\calc\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\calculator\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\mspaint\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\notepad\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\ping\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\wordpad\\\.exe$") OR TargetImage = RGX("\\\\write\\\.exe$")) AND GrantedAccess = "0x1FFFFF")
